## About
Centennial Motors works on one kind of car: Mercedes-Benz. Our tools, computers and know-how are all built around Mercedes service, so when your car comes in, we already know it well.
Charlie Firouzabadi owns the shop and heads up service. He is a Mercedes Master Tech who has also restored antique cars. Cyrus Firouzabadi, also an owner, heads up sales and helps people find a new or pre-owned Mercedes that fits their life and their budget.
You'll find us at 2965 Holcomb Bridge Rd, Ste B1 in Alpharetta. Customers have given us a 4.5 rating across 50 Google reviews.

## Services
- Scheduled maintenance: Regular Mercedes service intervals, including Service A, B, C and D.
- Transmission rebuilds: Transmission rebuilds done in-house by a team with specialized transmission training.
- Electrical problems: Batteries, battery drain and lighting issues.
- Emissions and inspections: Vehicle inspections, emission control work, and help if your car failed emission testing.
- Vintage Mercedes restorations: Meet with our specialist to plan and rebuild a vintage Mercedes.
- New and pre-owned Mercedes: We help you figure out the best model for your lifestyle and budget.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8 am to 5 pm. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I set up an appointment outside business hours?
A: Yes. Send us an email or give us a call and we'll get you on the schedule.

Q: Do you offer pick up and drop off?
A: We offer courtesy pick up and drop off within a 15 mile radius.
